body:
GitHub beamfall/corvint#774, filed by the owner 2026-10-11. 

## Problem
RVN-V0 binds a passing Playwright receipt to *steps* of one flow. Suites still re-prove the same screen-to-screen transition (login -> dashboard -> section -> sub-screen) in dozens of tests because nothing records that an edge is already proven at a revision, and nothing lets a test declare "I depend on edge E being proven" and enter by deep link instead.

## Proposal
`corvint flows appmap edges --map FILE [--receipt FILE]... [--revision REV]` emitting `application-edge-ledger/0`:
- Edge identity = (from screen, to screen, trigger kind: goto | click selector | redirect | form submit) keyed by stable element IDs.
- Each edge row: PROVEN@REV (with the receipt/test key and the step that crossed it), UNVERIFIED_AT_HEAD (an anchor on the edge's lineage changed), CONTRADICTED, or UNPROVEN.
- A `--require EDGE_ID` mode for tests: a test may declare `proves:` and `assumes:` edge lists (annotation or sidecar); the ledger reports assumed edges that are not PROVEN at the evaluated revision, so a suite can fail closed.
- Coverage summary: proven/total edges per app and the cheapest test (fewest steps) that proves each edge.

## Acceptance criteria
- Deterministic ledger digest per revision; capped projection with omitted counts.
- An edge proven by one receipt is reported once with every other test that also crosses it listed as `redundant-crossers` (count + keys).
- Changing a template or selector anchored on an edge flips it to UNVERIFIED_AT_HEAD.
- `assumes:` an UNPROVEN or stale edge exits 1 with the edge list; no browser is launched.
